novelty_scope: Compared with the inspected implementations in this repository and the 57 public sibling repositories inventoried on 2026-10-10. No claim of global novelty.
ranking_rule: expected HOLDOUT-DTI gain per experiment-hour, then per new-data dependency. A hypothesis is only promoted if its paired holdout CI is strictly positive under the exact evaluator; no submission slot is spent before the uniqueness ruling (IR-S7-02).

budget.note: Session 7 ran zero new hypothesis experiments: it finalised the H57-M emission and ran two measurement passes.

candidates.hypothesis: Localised budget allocation beats the uniform density transfer at the same 43,950-dot budget
layers: Retained H57-M posterior from visible faults only
Withheld-positive distance distribution (median 13.44 px; p90 25.55 px)
Per-cell marginal bar dT > c(1-k), c = alpha*DTI/(1-alpha*DTI)
candidates.signature: Spend the budget where the fitted strand intensity is high instead of thinning it uniformly: the shipped H57-M emission is the exact-curve optimum rescaled by area, which is a uniform dot rate along the band; a marginal-bar allocation would concentrate the same number of dots on the top-decile cells of the same posterior.
candidates.why_missing_faults: Same mechanism as H57-M (relay/bend damage zones); the change is only how the fixed budget is distributed along the fitted intensity.
candidates.difference_from_repo: All previous emissions used emit_decimated/emit_prefix with a uniform per-cell cap; the surrogate-argmax selector is retracted (IR-S7-01), so the marginal rule has never been evaluated under the exact evaluator at a fixed budget.
candidates.expected_improvement: Unknown magnitude; must exceed the paired 95% CI floor to be promoted. Upper bound: the exact curve moves +0.056 between the 40k and 10k points, so allocation shape is worth more than density.
candidates.implementation_cost: 1 experiment (~40 min CPU): reuse the cached posterior, re-run the exact evaluator on the four folds.
candidates.non_fault_mimic: Concentrating on high posterior cells can also concentrate on a single mapped system; per-fold CI and the distance-only control must both be reported.
candidates.status: not started; next session's rank-1 experiment

candidates.hypothesis: Segment-tip and along-strike termination anatomy: strands concentrate near visible-segment tips and stepovers rather than uniformly along traces
layers: Visible component tips and endpoint curvature at 3 px and 9 px scales
Distance to nearest tip vs distance to trace interior
H57-M relay geometry as the conditioning frame
candidates.signature: Fit per-fault secondary-strand intensity as a function of along-strike position s/L (tip vs middle) with tip distance as a covariate; no textbook angle imposed.
candidates.why_missing_faults: Tip damage and linkage zones are where new short strands are most often mapped; compilations truncate them.
candidates.difference_from_repo: H57-H/I2/J used bend and relay geometry, never along-trace position s/L or tip proximity.
candidates.expected_improvement: Modest but cheap; a strictly positive paired CI over the H57-M arm is the promotion bar.
candidates.non_fault_mimic: Digitisation vertices create artificial tips; a tip must be a component endpoint, not a digitising node.

candidates.hypothesis: Geophysical edge corroboration (magnetic horizontal gradient, tilt derivative, detrended elevation and its slope) raises precision of the strand posterior at the same budget
layers: Official 19-band training_features.tif planes 3/6/12/19 (tmi_hg, tc, det_elev, det_elev_slope)
H57-M posterior as the prior (likelihood only, never catalogue-derived)
Per-fold leakage canary on every added column
candidates.signature: GBM conditioned on anatomy + geo edge planes; identical emission rule to H57-M so the comparison isolates the likelihood.
candidates.why_missing_faults: Secondary strands with little topographic expression may still have magnetic/conductivity edges.
candidates.difference_from_repo: Session-5 geo work was blocked because the 419 MB stack was not present; geo planes were never evaluated on the corrected strike frame.
candidates.expected_improvement: Potentially the largest of the four; unknown sign on the holdout (geo edges also fire on non-fault contacts).
candidates.implementation_cost: 2 experiments (~90 min) plus ~420 MB feature restore through the pinned five-part bridge (free, public, SHA256-verified).
candidates.non_fault_mimic: Dikes, lithologic contacts, flight-line leveling residuals and variable survey clearance mimic strands; area-2 line spacing (400 m) is coarser than the 300 m kernel.
candidates.status: not started; needs the feature stack restored in a new session

candidates.hypothesis: Second independent whole-component holdout draw confirms or breaks the +0.0287 relay-band gain
layers: A second predeclared buffered whole-component LOQO draw (different seed and cluster order)
candidates.signature: Re-run the exact evaluator on a new spatial blocking; the promotion bar is the same strictly positive paired CI.
candidates.why_missing_faults: Not a discovery hypothesis: it is the stability test the current single draw cannot provide.
candidates.difference_from_repo: All H57-M readings so far condition on one buffered split (seed 20, 153 physical 20 km clusters).
candidates.expected_improvement: No expected score gain; it converts a single-draw result into a distributional statement.
candidates.non_fault_mimic: Not applicable; this is an instrument-stability test.

candidates.hypothesis: Airborne-magnetic flight-line mimic suppression before any geo-edge feature is trusted
layers: Survey flight-line geometry (spacing/heading) for the GeoDAWN blocks
Directional filtering of the magnetic planes along line azimuth
candidates.signature: Measure the fraction of fitted strand intensity explained by survey-parallel linear features and remove it; only then use the magnetic planes as likelihood.
candidates.why_missing_faults: Suppresses false positives rather than finding new strands: it protects H57-G from the known leveling-residual mimic.
candidates.difference_from_repo: Never attempted in this repository; requires external survey-geometry metadata.
candidates.implementation_cost: 1-2 experiments, but first requires bridging USGS ScienceBase/national-map survey metadata, which sandbox binary egress blocks today.
candidates.non_fault_mimic: This hypothesis is about a mimic.
candidates.status: blocked on external data placement; last by cost
